content_sections.heading: DSCI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DSCI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DSCI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DSCI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Delhi State Cancer Institutes (DSCI) to fill Senior Resident vacancies on a contractual basis under advertisement number RECTT./16/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DSCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies available for Senior Resident posts across various specialized disciplines like Clinical Oncology, Onco-Anaesthesia, Nuclear Medicine, and more.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates are required to report directly to the designated venue with all necessary documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026. Candidates must report at the Director's Office at DSCI East by 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for DSCI Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years as on the walk-in date, with provisions for age relaxation at the discretion of the Selection Board.
